tr: 🚗 Yeni araba modelleri: sedan, hatchback, SUV, pikap, minibüs, taksi, kamyon (gerçekçi renkler, gece stop lambaları)
🏡 4 farklı müstakil ev: beşik çatılı, iki katlı, garajlı, modern havuzlu
🏢 Gerçekçi cepheler: apartman, ofis ve gökdelenlerde tek tek pencereler, gece rastgele yanan ışıklar
🏙️ Yeni gökdelen tipleri: cam kule, kademeli kule, klasik kule; sıra evler ve L planlı apartmanlar
en: 🚗 New car models: sedan, hatchback, SUV, pickup, van, taxi, truck (realistic colors, brake lights at night)
🏡 4 kinds of houses: gabled, two-storey, with garage, modern with pool
🏢 Realistic facades: individual windows on apartments, offices and towers, randomly lit at night
🏙️ New tower types: glass, stepped and classic towers; row houses and L-shaped apartment blocks
